title: thalictrum montanum subsp. collinum
intro: Thalictrum montanum subsp. collinum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral agent, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Meadow Rue include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects. The plant's bioactive compounds also exhibit antimicrobial and antiparasitic properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine for treating a range of health conditions.
